habit_scope: Well-drained site: main excavation only to the top of the footings; footings formed by trenching. CMHC Ch6. Canadian / NBC — confirm AHJ; not IRC. Alt to the full basement hole (m-P04-full-excavation). Still needs space outside the footing for the drainage pipe.
how_it_is_done: CMHC Ch6: 'If a site is well drained and only a dampproofing membrane is used without the granular base underneath, the main excavation need only extend to the elevation of the top surface of the footings. When this is done, the footings are formed by trenching. Adequate space must be provided for the drainage pipe outside the footing.' Canadian / NBC — confirm AHJ; not IRC.
Still: no frozen subgrade; do not fill an over-dig; utility locate already done; footing inspect before pour (ORNL).

Do not use this as a skip of workspace when you still have to dampproof a tall basement wall from the outside, or when a granular base under the slab is required — CMHC limits this alt to well-drained + dampproof membrane without the granular base.
US books (ORNL/HUD/AF&PA) do not print this trench-to-top-of-footing shortcut as a numbered habit. Treat as Canadian-sourced alt; confirm AHJ.
inspection_hold_points: Same ORNL footing inspect before pour. Confirm the site is actually well drained before skipping the full workspace (CMHC). Confirm AHJ.
when_this_beats_habit: Well-drained site, dampproof only, no granular base under the slab (CMHC). Confirm AHJ.
when_this_is_a_bad_idea: Wet site, waterproofed basement, granular base under slab, or a US AHJ that wants the full workspace. Do not copy as IRC habit.
why_tier1_never_learned_it: Most cold-country crews dig the full hole. This is a well-drained shortcut in a Canadian book — confirm the AHJ.
permit_gate: should be on drawings before permit
permit_gate_notes: If the drawings show a full basement workspace and you trench instead, that is a field change. Confirm with AHJ / engineer. Canadian / NBC — not IRC.
risk_if_swapped_late: Switching to a full hole after trenching, or the reverse, changes form access and drain-pipe layout. Catch on the drawings.
plain_language_summary: On a dry site the Canadian book allows you to dig only to the top of the footings and trench the footings, leaving room outside for the drain pipe. That is not a US/IRC habit. Confirm the AHJ. Do not use it on a wet lot.
spanish_summary: En un sitio seco el libro canadiense permite cavar solo hasta el tope de las zapatas y zanjarlas, dejando espacio afuera para el tubo de drenaje. No es hábito IRC. Confirme el AHJ. No lo use en un lote mojado.
locators: CMHC Ch6 Excavation Size and Depth (printed p 62): well drained, excavation to top of footings, trenching, space for drainage pipe
confidence_notes: Sourced in CMHC only as a well-drained shortcut. Labeled Canadian. Med because it is not in ORNL/HUD/AF&PA as a US habit.
remodel_note: Remodel extras (matching, occupied-site, shoring, demo of an existing house) are not a sequence in CMHC/ORNL/HUD/FM — Gap, do not invent remodel-only methods. Essential Guide is framing-only (opened 2026-08-30; silent on site/layout). B&D Room Additions not used as a P00–P06 sequence.
layering: Main excavation to top of footings; trenches for footings; drain-pipe space outside. Canadian / NBC — confirm AHJ; not IRC.
code_to_check: Canadian / NBC — confirm AHJ; not IRC. Do not invent an IRC trench-footing section.

walkthroughs.title: How to lay out and dig a foundation: Building The Farmhouse | Day 1
walkthroughs.what_it_shows: Field: laser grade, string layout, bucket-width footing trenches, widen basement, porch piers. Trench stays alt, not habit. No batter boards, no survey pins — do not file as P03. 2-story is later Day 14/16, not this clip. Confirm AHJ; Canadian trench shortcut is not IRC habit.

inspector_looks_for: Trench on undisturbed soil; space outside the footing for drain pipe (CMHC). Footing inspect before pour (ORNL).
do_not_cheap: Do not skip drain-pipe space outside the footing (CMHC). Do not use this alt on a wet site or where a granular base under the slab is required. Footing inspect before pour.
smart_save: Shallower main hole on a well-drained site (CMHC). Not a skip of drain pipe space. No dollars. Confirm AHJ — Canadian / NBC; not IRC.
